topics.title: Kamala Das and the setting of the poem

concepts.learning_objective: Recall key facts about Kamala Das and recognise the qualities of her writing seen in this poem.
Trace the situation of the poem: the drive from the parents' home to Cochin airport and the parting there.
Interpret the image of the dozing mother's face, 'ashen like that of a corpse', and the realisation it brings.
Explain why the mother is compared to a 'late winter's moon'.

topics.title: Contrast: young trees and merry children

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the image of the young trees 'sprinting' and what it suggests.
Analyse how the images of youth outside the car contrast with the ageing mother.

topics.title: The parting: fear, smile and the poem's structure

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the 'old familiar ache' as the poet's childhood fear of losing her mother.
Interpret the parting words 'see you soon, Amma' and the repeated smile.
Recognise that the poem is a single sentence and explain the effect of this form.
